pages.title: Configuration
pages.text: Hexalia provides configurable settings for gameplay balance, block behavior, enchanted plants, and visual effects.

pages.title: Functional Blocks
pages.text: Several blocks can be adjusted to control their range, duration, and behavior.$(br2)$(li)Censer: effect radius and duration$(li)Small Cauldron: brewing and overcooking time$(li)Dreamcatcher: detection radius and burn duration$(li)Egg Cluster: hatch time

pages.title: Tools & Effects
pages.text: Item behavior and combat effects can be adjusted for balance and playstyle.$(br2)$(li)Mutation: item drop or block replacement$(li)Mandrake: scream radius and stun duration$(li)Throwable Sacs: effect duration$(li)Combat Effects: siphon radius and bleeding damage$(li)Cacofey: harvest radius

pages.title: Enchanted Plants
pages.text: All enchanted plants have configurable duration, radius, or intervals.$(br2)$(li)Nautilite, Windsong, Grimshade: duration and radius$(li)Astrylis: duration and growth interval$(li)Morphora: mutation radius$(li)Lourdes: duration and effect radius

pages.title: Client Settings
pages.text: Visual effects can be toggled independently on the client.$(br2)$(li)Ghost Fern particles$(li)Celestial Bloom particles$(li)Dreamshroom particles

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: Most settings apply server-side. 20 ticks equal 1 second. Back up your world before making major changes.
